description.value: Aperture Coffee Bar is a neighbourhood café located in the Walden Building on Main Street at King Edward, serving espresso drinks, tea, beer, wine, and an all-day food menu of breakfasts, sandwiches, and paninis. Originally established on W. Broadway, it relocated to Main Street where it now hosts a recurring live jazz and roots music series in an intimate back-room venue. The space is designed as an unhurried community gathering spot, making it a comfortable stop for a meal or drink at any point in the day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record on name, address, and phone. The menu page explicitly lists a 'Gluten free' bagel option and a 'Veggie Panini', confirming GF and vegetarian offerings. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: The email address listed on the website (aperturecoffeebarmain@gmail.com) is explicitly noted as intended for live music event booking, not general customer contact; no separate general-inquiry email is provided.
Address on website includes full postal code (V5V 3P7) not present in the OSM record — OSM address updated to website version.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating café on Main Street — a key Vancouver cycling corridor — with a full food and drink menu and extended daily hours. A useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists even though bike-specific amenities could not be confirmed from the website.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a 'Veggie Panini' (zucchini, red pepper, eggplant, spinach on rosemary focaccia) and a 'Gluten free' bagel option explicitly noted alongside plain and everything bagels
